scope: Audit whether another public or local real-GT head benchmark is immediately ready after G33.

routes.name: H3DS v2
routes.reason: Local wheel/config only; no H3DS_ACCESS_TOKEN or dataset files available.

routes.name: FaceScape
routes.reason: Toolkit/sample metadata exists locally, but sample has only limited images and redistribution is blocked; full licensed case is required.

routes.name: Multiface
routes.reason: Local debug compact case is already the current G21-G33 route; it is not a new benchmark and G33 shows no quality gain.

routes.name: NeRSemble
routes.reason: No compact local dataset found; access/download is required before a gate.

routes.name: Wikimedia/Blender CC0 head
routes.reason: Repo-safe synthetic plumbing control, not a real-capture benchmark.

decision: No additional ready real-GT quality benchmark is available locally. A new quality milestone requires H3DS token/access, licensed FaceScape/NeRSemble data, or another audited real-capture dataset.
artifact_policy: No new media was generated for this benchmark availability gate.
